title: Twitch CEO Predicts GTA6 Online Might Land Next Year
description: Rockstar remains tight-lipped about the GTA6 multiplayer component, but Twitch's CEO reckons it will launch next year. Here is the latest update.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Multiplayer: What Do We Know So Far?

As the release date for Rockstar Games' highly anticipated open-world epic approaches, details regarding its long-term ecosystem continue to be a hot topic in the gaming community. However, Rockstar has remained very tight-lipped about GTA6's multiplayer component, the potential successor to GTA5's incredibly popular Grand Theft Auto Online, not yet commenting on whether it will even launch one.

All we know currently is that when Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives on November 19th, it will only include the single-player campaign. This has left many fans wondering about the rollout strategy for the inevitable online experience.

## Twitch CEO Weighs In on Online Release Window

While the developers at Rockstar have kept their cards close to their chest, industry figures are beginning to share their expectations. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, Twitch's CEO reckons that the multiplayer mode will land next year.

It is important to note that this comment is currently a prediction rather than an official confirmation from Rockstar Games. Given the massive scale of the franchise and the precedent set by previous titles, the community will have to wait for official announcements regarding any online rollout plans.

## Editor's Take

With Rockstar focusing solely on the single-player campaign for the November 19th launch, speculation like the Twitch CEO's comments highlights the immense anticipation surrounding the game's future multiplayer ecosystem. Until Rockstar speaks up, players should temper expectations regarding online gameplay at launch.
